## Checklist

- [ ] Claims added or changed are sourced (link or citation in the PR or the text)
- [ ] Numbers (case counts, byte counts, dates) are verified against the underlying work
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, or internal identifiers added
- [ ] Links resolve (checked each changed/added link)
- [ ] Wording stays in the brief's voice: plain, checkable, no lobbying jargon
